review:
Pure retro: fruits, lucky sevens and Scatters, with no respin bonus to learn. Scatters pay on their own whenever 3, 4 or 5 land anywhere, without needing a payline.

The big moments come from walls of matching symbols. As the reels fill up with the same symbol, they start to burn, and a full wall is where the biggest wins are. Wazdan rates it medium volatility with a 2,500x max win and a 96.15% RTP. It's a step up in volatility from Mighty Hot: Amazonia, so expect the walls to take longer to come together. A good game for classic-slot fans who like a bit of build-up.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
